prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Your new desktop pet is officially registered! Confirm details to finalize adoption.", "Pet Preview", "Certified Companion"]
1: ["Save Your New Desktop Pet", "Sign in or create an account to securely sync your newly adopted pet across all devices."]
2: ["How to Interact with Your Pet", "Drag your pet anywhere on your screen. Right-click the pet to open controls, send messages, or adjust visibility.", "Got It!"]
3: ["Choose Your Pet's Personality", "Select traits that define how your pet behaves on your desktop.", "Continue", "Energetic, Calm, Playful, Curious"]
4: ["Select Your Adoption Journey", "Pick a ready-to-play companion or create a custom pet from your photos."]
5: ["Signing in with your existing account automatically restores all previously adopted desktop pets and progress."]
6: ["Includes Free Starter Accessory Pack"]
7: ["Preparing Your Desktop Companion", "We are assembling animations and setting up your pet on your desktop."]
8: ["Your Desktop Pet Has Arrived!", "Look at your screen! Click and drag your pet anywhere. Right-click your pet to bring up interaction options or send messages.", "Start Playing"]
9: ["We can send a desktop notification as soon as your pet is ready to play."]
